jobs.title: CPS Account Program Manager
jobs.description:
Joining Collibra’s CPS Account Program Manager team

The Account Program Manager (APM) serves as the strategic partner and relationship manager for Collibra Public Sector’s Federal customers. This role is integral to ensuring customer satisfaction, driving adoption, and delivering value from Collibra’s solutions while collaborating closely with our Services and other GTM teams to create a seamless and resilient customer journey. This role directly influences retention, advocacy, and long-term account success.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between customer mission needs and our software solutions, coordinating the technical team towards delivering successful implementation, adoption, and value. The APMs primary responsibility is to partner closely with sales, services, support, customer engineering, and product teams to proactively safeguard account health, revenue, and customer satisfaction, by proactively identifying and mitigating risk, preventing and managing escalations, and assessing customer health.

Account Program Managers at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

Relationship building and management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned federal accounts, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, system integrators and partners.

- Establish long-term relationships within assigned government customers while developing an understanding of the client’s strategic goals and overall impact on business results.

- Understand customers' business objectives, technical needs, and success criteria, aligning Collibra’s services to meet their goals.

- Support renewals and expansion by demonstrating technical value and best practices.

- Understand customer mission objectives and map them to product capabilities.

Advocacy and operational readiness

- Provide guidance during onboarding, deployment, upgrades, and ongoing operations.

- Coordinate technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution design sessions.

- Assist with documentation, technical presentations, and briefings for government stakeholders.

- Coordinate product functionality and roadmap meetings between product customers and the customer.

Planning and project management

- Coordinate Support, Services and Customer Engineering on customer projects and initiatives by providing project leadership and guidance based on customer overall objectives.

- Align services delivery with customer’s business needs by ensuring successful project execution and implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer goals.

- Drive customer alignment on goals, success criteria, and acceptance milestones.

- Track project progress and provide regular status updates to customers and internal leadership.

- Understand the customer’s high-level business challenges while functioning as an advisory resource for “Best Practices” in driving adoption of Collibra’s solutions.

- Manage scope, risks, issues, and dependencies across multiple concurrent projects.

- Deliver reports for customers as required based on business objectives.

Health assessment and risk prevention

- Identify and track key customer risk indicators (usage, sentiment, support volume, executive engagement, compliance).

- Lead the effort with Sales and the technical teams to identify customer risk, performance issues, and opportunities for optimization.

- Help customers avoid and/or mitigate issues with proactive guidance based on extensive customer experience.

- Advocate for customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and prioritization.

Escalation prevention and management

- Act as point of contact for managing escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution with Support, Product, and Engineering.

- Provide clear and constructive product feedback to Collibra’s Product Management teams based on customer use-cases and requirements.

- Be a customer advocate to ensure that escalations are resolved in a timely fashion.

You have

- 5+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role (TAM, Solutions Engineer, Systems Engineer, or similar)

- Experience supporting U.S. federal government customers (civilian, DoD, or IC)

- Strong understanding of enterprise software, SaaS, or cloud-based solutions

- Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Experience working in regulated or high-security environments

- Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills

- Experience deploying enterprise solutions

- Knowledge of government hierarchy and operations

- Strong business insight and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders at all levels

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially GovCloud or equivalent

- Experience working with system integrators

- Knowledge of government hierarchy and operations

- A solid technical background in data management

- Active or eligible U.S. Government security clearance

- Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil

You are

- Exceptional in communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships within government entities

- Fast learner with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences

- Excellent in communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills

Measures of success

- Within the first 30 days

- Understand your customers objectives and ongoing efforts

- Identify account risks and project blockers

- Attend account team meetings for assigned accounts

- Within the first 60 days

- Develop a Success Plan for each assigned customer based on their objectives and ongoing efforts

- Develop a remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales and technical teams

- Participate in account team meetings for assigned accounts

- Identify key customer contacts at all levels

- Within the first 90 days

- Begin to execute the Success Plan for each assigned customer

- Begin to execute the remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales and technical teams

- Lead account team meetings for assigned accounts

- Begin to develop a relationship with key customer contacts at all levels

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $104,000 - $130,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .

jobs.title: General Manager, Collibra Public Sector
jobs.description:
Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent.  Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.

Successful outcomes

- Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm

- Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts

- Manage overall expense to revenue targets

- Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities

- Work closely with the parent to drive the overall Public Sector product roadmap and align any support needed from the shared services teams

- Maintain positive evaluations from relevant government agencies such as DCSA

Characteristics

- Demonstrated ability to manage directly and delegate effectively across all areas of responsibilities

- Create a culture of trust and accountability within Collibra Public Sector

- Know when to build consensus and when to maintain autonomy

- Bold risk-taking based on deep understanding of complex data

- Politically astute when dealing with diverse stakeholders and conflicting demands

Experience

- Experience managing a complete public sector subsidiary within a larger organization

- Extended positions with increasing levels of responsibilities within enterprise software companies

- Successful execution of business transformations and realignments

- Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
Joining Collibra's People team as a Senior People Partner, GTM & AI

You will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to two of Collibra's fastest-growing teams, Deasy Labs, our AI unstructured data team, and our Customer Organization inclusive of Customer Engineering, Professional Services, and Support. This is not a traditional HRBP role. You will operate like an internal organizational consultant, identifying problems, interrogating data, forming a POV, and driving solutions without waiting to be told what to do

If you already use AI as a core part of how you work and are energized by building people strategy in a high-growth, AI-forward environment, this role was built for you

This is a hybrid role based in our New York office. Our hybrid model means you'll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team.

Senior People Partners at Collibra are responsible for

- Partnering with business leaders on workforce transformation as AI reshapes roles and team structures, including role redesign, change management, and helping managers effectively lead hybrid human-AI teams

- Building relationships with leaders to proactively identify, design, and develop targeted People strategies that drive business outcomes, leveraging workforce analytics, AI-assisted insights, and direct business partnership to improve productivity, retention, and organizational health

- Providing strategic business partnership, thought leadership, and coaching at all levels of the organization

- Embedding People programs into business strategies including Performance Management, Learning & Development, Rewards, and Employee Experience in ways that directly support business objectives

- Mitigating risk by proactively aligning compliance practices with country-specific requirements and serving as the primary point of contact for employee relations matters across the United States and, as needed, other supported regions

You have

- 3+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner or People Partner directly supporting a customer-facing or revenue organization such as Customer Success, Sales, Sales Engineering, or Professional Services

- Experience with a global organization, specifically the United States and EMEA

- Familiarity with how AI is changing workforce design, skills requirements, and manager-employee dynamics

- Experience using data to identify insights that drive action, including demonstrated ability to go from data to insight to recommendation to outcome

- Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices including risk assessment, bias mitigation, and quality and accuracy reviews

- Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows

- A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience is required

- This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship

You are

- A curious, adaptive learner who treats AI as a professional multiplier — you are actively building your own AI workflow, not waiting to be trained on it

- Someone who operates like an internal organizational consultant — you identify the problem, interrogate the data, form a POV, and drive the solution without waiting to be told what to do

- An effective communicator and critical thinker who demonstrates empathy and experience driving collaborative work across functions and levels

- Experienced in project management and change management with a track record of influencing and strategically solving problems in fast-moving environments

- Someone who thrives in constantly changing environments and builds trusted relationships across teams quickly

Measures of success

- Within your first month, you will have met every individual on the Deasy Labs team, understand the business strategy and how every role contributes, met every Director+ leader in the CCO org, and have a clear picture of organizational talent

- Within your third month, you will own the workforce plan for both Deasy Labs and the Customer Organization and have established trusted relationships with key business leaders across both teams

- Within your sixth month, you will have driven at least one meaningful people strategy recommendation that connects directly to a business outcome for your client groups

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $168,000 - $210,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.
